 Ditch Paper IRS Form 941: Ultimate Q3 Survival Move for Accountants & SMBs
 News provided by
 Halfpricesoft.com
 Oct 26, 2026, 06:00 ET
 Share this article
 Share to X 
 Share this article
 Share to X 
 Streamline Q3 tax deadline on Nov 2, 2026. Use the e941 add-on to upload & e-file Form 941 in ezPaycheck.
 REDMOND, Wash. , Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Halfpricesoft.com has announced structural updates to its ezPaycheck payroll platform, offering small business owners and accountants an accelerated path to meet the upcoming third-quarter IRS Form 941 electronic filing deadline on Monday, November 2, 2026 . Instead of navigating the uncertainties of physical mail tracking or complex federal authorization setups, companies can utilize the software's integrated e-filing feature to transmit quarterly tax forms directly to the IRS.
 Continue Reading
 Enter payroll, mid-year with ezPaycheck for payroll and year end tax form processing
 Speed
 Speed 
 -->
 Download and try ezPaycheck now to e-file 941 forms before the November 2nd deadline! 
 "ezPaycheck is an exceptionally easy-to-navigate platform that offers impeccable customer support to help small businesses seamlessly process payroll and forms, in-house." said Dr. Ge, Founder of Halfpricesoft.com .
 The 2026-2027 ezPaycheck bundle is available at a promotional price of $289 (regularly $378). Acquiring this combo mid-year provides a head start on compiling data for seamless year-end tax filing. To ensure the software fits specific business needs, a 30-day free trial is available to test for compatibility and begin data entry.
 Why E-Filing Beat Paper Every Time 
 The Old Paper Route 
 The ezPaycheck E-File Upgrade 
 Mail Delays & Lost Mail: Risky submission relying on physical delivery dates. 
 Direct Transmission: Sends data straight to the IRS instantly. 
 Silent Failures: Weeks of wondering if your filing actually arrived. 
 Instant Confirmation: Get immediate IRS verification upon receipt. 
 Manual Calculation Typos: One misplaced digit triggers a costly fine. 
 Built-in Verification: System checks lower rejection rates and error fines. 
 Last-Minute Panic: Must be postmarked days ahead to stay safe. 
 Deadline-Day Flexibility: File securely right up through November 2. 
 Get the details of the latest e941 efile add-on feature here 
 Beyond tax season, ezPaycheck is built for full-spectrum payroll management. Whether you're paying hourly staff, salaried workers, or 1099 contractors, the platform handles standard tax calculations, paystub generation, and year-end form printing (W-2, W-3, 940, 941, and 943).
 Zero-Internet Payroll: Unlike subscription cloud apps, ezPaycheck runs locally on your desktop. You process payroll completely offline, keeping sensitive employee financial data entirely private.
 Annual Regulatory Updates: Software updates roll out every year to keep you 100% compliant with changing federal and state tax laws.
 Full E-File Coverage: Seamlessly e-file both your quarterly Form 941 and annual Form 940 directly from the interface.
 Don't gamble with late penalties this quarter. You can test-drive ezPaycheck with a 30-day free trial  and no credit card required. Ready to lock in your setup for the long haul? Grab the 2026–2027 ezPaycheck Bundle for $289 (discounted from the standard $378 per calendar year edition).
 About Halfpricesoft 
 Halfpricesoft is a leading provider of small business software solutions, including payroll accounting, tax compliance utilities, and bank-grade check printing software. Serving over 20,000 businesses across the United States since 2003, the firm prioritizes reliable offline architecture paired with accessible customer support to eliminate expensive enterprise costs for growing organizations.
